utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m still up for helping with the repair drive; what do you need me to take on first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late. Could you start by sorting the donated tools and setting aside anything that needs parts?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll sort through the donated tools and pull aside anything that needs parts. Once I’ve got a pile ready, I’ll let you know what we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help for an hour this weekend—what needs hauling first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Before I say what to haul first, can you remind me which day and roughly what time you’re free this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free Saturday around 10 to 11 if that works. If not, I can probably do Sunday late morning instead.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running count of tape, gloves, and trash bags for the repair drive—tell me what Noah still needs and I’ll check it off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I still need a roll of tape and maybe two pairs of gloves—I keep forgetting if I already grabbed the trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’m marking you down for one roll of tape and two pairs of gloves, and I’ll leave the trash bags unchecked for now until you confirm.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help, but I want a clear list first—tools, pickup times, and where everything’s getting stored so nothing goes missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, I’ll put together a simple list with the tools, pickup times, and storage spot, then I’ll bring it by so we can go over it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, how many homes are actually signed up for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard it second-hand, but I think around eight homes have signed up so far.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Around eight isn’t much—who’s coordinating the signup list, and have they started knocking on the rest of the block yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, I heard folks are pitching in for the repair drive—sounds like it’s finally getting some real momentum.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure does, Tess. I told folks they can borrow my ladder and drill if it helps keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s mighty generous of you, Gus—I’ll be sure to tell the others you’ve got the ladder and drill ready. With neighbors like this, we might just get the whole thing sorted quicker than expected.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal, we should get the repair drive moving this weekend—I'll start inviting folks up and down the block today.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good—once you’ve got a list, tell me which houses confirmed and I’ll keep track of who’s in on each stretch of the block.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll start with Maple and Cedar this afternoon and let you know which houses say yes so you can map out the block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re able to handle the tool pickup first, Sam? I just want to be sure before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can handle the tool pickup first. You can count on me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m pulling the repair drive list together now, and I’d love your help making sure we don’t miss anyone on the block.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can do a quick skim and flag any houses that jump out, but keep it simple for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you — I’ll send you the short list this afternoon, and if any house jumps out as needing repairs or a check-in, just mark it for me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m telling folks about the repair drive so more neighbors show up, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Vik. If you want, make me a simple list of what to tell people and when the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, Eli — I’ll tell people it’s a repair drive, what to bring, and when it starts, then I’ll repeat that around the block so more neighbors hear it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, it slipped my mind for a second. Are we still meeting by the community center?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, by the community center still. I can make it, just might be a little quiet today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries at all, Uli—thanks for letting me know. I’ll be there, and I can handle the chatting if you’re not up for it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I’m in for the repair drive—want me to help pull a few folks together from both sides of the block?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Jules—if you can ask around both sides of the block, I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll check in with folks on both sides this afternoon and point anyone interested your way.
